notes: Most of phase 19 is implemented and tested, but three criteria are not met as written: the deliveries endpoint has no handler-level test, the invalid-healthcheck docs and UI mapping do not match what the API returns, and the Rollback step shows no duration. | findings: 19-06 A2 / 19-07 A1: healthchecks.mdx and error-codes.mdx say an out-of-bounds healthcheck is rejected with SERVICE_INPUT_INVALID and reason HEALTHCHECK_CONFIG_INVALID. The route body schemas (HealthcheckInputSchema in service-schemas.ts) run first, so the real response is 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with issues; the 422 SERVICE_INPUT_INVALID path is not reachable through POST/PATCH. docs/deploy-engine.md correctly says 400. The accuracy test only checks that the code string appears in the page, so it did not catch this.; 19-02 A2: mapHealthcheckFailure in healthcheck-form.ts only handles 422 SERVICE_INPUT_INVALID with a HEALTHCHECK_ reason, and the ServiceSheet test mocks exactly that. When the real API rejects a healthcheck (400 VALIDATION_FAILED with issues), ServiceSheet falls through to the generic save-failed banner instead of the named error, so the UI path for a client/server disagreement is untested against the real response shape.; 19-03 A3 / H3: GET /api/projects/:projectId/services/:serviceId/webhook/deliveries has no handler-level test (no route or DB-backed test). services.test.ts only covers the zod query schema and cursor encode/decode. The 400 on a malformed cursor, keyset paging, per-service scoping and absence of payload fields are verified by reading, not by a test.; 19-01 A1: the Rollback row in DeploymentSteps is rendered with durationMs=null, so it has state but no duration, while the criterion asks for each step to show duration and state.; 19-04 / DoD accessibility: RollbackDialog is a hand-rolled role=dialog aria-modal with Escape handling but no focus trap or focus restoration. This does not block the criteria, but a modal dialog should have both.; 19-03 H1: no test asserts that the webhook secret never reaches localStorage, the URL or console; only clearing on unmount, rotate and disable is tested.; 19-06 A3: the human approval line in docs/ui-review/phase-19/REPORT.md ('aprobada por el usuario') is an uncommitted working-tree edit (earlier committed version said 'pendiente'). Commit it with the user's confirmation recorded. The report itself has no BLOCK; its FLAGs (dialog lacks a replacement-downtime warning, Health check vs Healthcheck copy, deliveries show 'Deployed' for a push that later rolled back) are deferred.; 19-05: the @e2e-engine specs were reviewed by reading only (they need the Docker deploy host). The HMAC over exact bytes, wrong-key, tampered-bytes, ping, per-run random secret, sampler window and redelivery assertions are present in the code.
